name: ccmax-monitor-release-bot
description: semantic-release for terrylica/ccmax-monitor: push tags/commits, publish GitHub Releases + binary assets, comment on issues & PRs. Injected as GH_TOKEN via `vault run ccmax-release`. Closes issue #32, which recorded the stopgap of borrowing the operator's ambient `gh auth token` (a gho_* OAuth token carrying gist+read:org+repo across ALL repos) — bound to one human's interactive login, unusable unattended, and far broader than a release needs. Scoped to this repo only.
